info.desc: Holy Money is the fourth studio album by Swans. The album was recorded in the same sessions as A Screw and Greed. Being a No Wave album, its heaviness and artistic experimentation along with musical minimalism made it very influential for a number of diverse genres and artists; thus, the album had a direct influence on genres such as Sludge Metal, Drone and both heavy and experimental or artistic genres in general, which is why bands such as Godflesh, Khanate and Sunn O))) have cited the importance of this album. The first CD issue contained the A Screw EP as .

podcast.body: This album, released in the mid-80s, marked a new revolution for Swans with the incorporation of Jarboe into the group. Jarboe's contributions in music and her presence as a singer and a woman helped make the band less noisy and aggressive, and more melodic, leading to increased popularity and more reviews (though not necessarily good ones until the band became truly famous). Despite the shift, the album maintained a strong artistic charge. "Holy Money" (referred to as "Jolly Money" in the transcript) is considered one of the most interesting albums for fans of Noise Rock and Industrial Rock origins. "Los discos en mitad de los 80 en los que se incorporan a Jarbo al grupo de 85, 86 como el Jolly Money son una nueva revolución dentro del campo de suans."
